english: Let $c$ be a real number and let $C_{1}:y=x^{2}$ and $C_{2}:y=-x^{2}+5x+c$. If each of the tangents drawn from the point $\left(\dfrac{5}{4},1\right)$ to $C_{1}$ also touches $C_{2}$, then the value of $c$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $c$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है तथा $C_{1}:y=x^{2}$ और $C_{2}:y=-x^{2}+5x+c$ हैं। यदि बिन्दु $\left(\dfrac{5}{4},1\right)$ से $C_{1}$ पर खींची गई प्रत्येक स्पर्श रेखा $C_{2}$ को भी स्पर्श करती है, तो $c$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Check with $y=x-\frac14$: $x^{2}-4x-\left(c+\frac14\right)=0$, $16+4c+1=0\Rightarrow c=-\frac{17}{4}$ (consistent: $C_{2}$ is the reflection of $C_{1}$ in the point, so both tangents are common).
solution_full: It passes through the external point $\left(\frac54,1\right)$ iff $1=\frac52a-a^{2}$, i.e. $2a^{2}-5a+2=0$, so $a=2$ or $a=\frac12$. ($1<\left(\frac54\right)^{2}$, so the point is outside $C_{1}$ and there are two tangents.)
$L_{1}$ touches $C_{2}$ iff $-x^{2}+5x+c=4x-4$, i.e. $x^{2}-x-(c+4)=0$, has a repeated root: $1+4(c+4)=0\Rightarrow c=-\frac{17}{4}$.
$L_{2}$ touches $C_{2}$ iff $x^{2}-4x-\left(c+\frac14\right)=0$ has a repeated root: $16+4\left(c+\frac14\right)=0\Rightarrow c=-\frac{17}{4}$.
Both conditions give the same value, so the requirement is consistent and $c=-\frac{17}{4}=-4.25$.

(Reason for the consistency: with $c=-\frac{17}{4}$, $C_{2}:y=2-\left(\frac52-x\right)^{2}$ is the image of $C_{1}$ under the point reflection in $\left(\frac54,1\right)$, which maps every line through that point to itself.)
originality_note: New: the two tangents from a point to one parabola are required to touch a second parabola; the hidden invariant is that the second parabola is the point reflection of the first in that point (way 4). Closest known: common tangents of y = x^2 and y = -x^2 + 4x - 4. Different because: the external-point tangents are found first and the second curve is fitted to them; the consistency of the two conditions is the point-symmetry.
blueprint_concepts: Tangent or normal drawn through an external point

concept_use.Tangent or normal drawn through an exter: Tangents from (5/4,1) to y = x^2 via a^2 - (5/2)a + 1 = 0.
concept_use.Common tangent/normal between two curves: Each tangent must also touch C2: discriminant zero gives c = -17/4 for both lines.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, curve and function introduced with its domain; conditions complete; one reading of each sentence; answer unique and equal to the plan (negative decimal); Hindi mirrors the English maths. Checked the point is outside C1 so two tangents exist and both conditions give the same c. No change.
key_step: Find the two tangents from the external point, then impose tangency to C2 by a zero discriminant.
justification: Standard chain (tangents from an external point, discriminant tangency) with no insight; similar demand to the parabola tangent anchor 2026-P2-Q2 (L2).
